name.description: The name of the legal entity.

type.description: The type of the legal entity.

parentId.description: The id of the parent legal entity.

customerGroups.description: The list of customer group IDs assigned to the legal entity.

entitiesAddresses.description: The list of location IDs assigned to the legal entity.

approvalGroup.description: The list of customer assignment IDs of an approval user group of the legal entity.

mixins.description: Mixins request. A map where a key represent mixins set name and a value represent a map with key-value pairs.

value.description: The purchasing limit for account in the legal entity.

legalName.description: The legal name of the entity.

registrationDate.description: The registration date of the legal entity in the ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2020-04-30T04:00:00.000Z.

taxRegistrationNumber.description: The tax registration number of the legal entity.

registrationAgency.description: The registration agency of the legal entity.

countryOfRegistration.description: The country in which the legal entity has been registered. The country needs to be defined and active in the Country Service.

registrationId.description: The unique identifier of the legal entity registration.

mixins.description: Links to the mixin schemas. A map where the keys represent mixins set attributes and the values represent url to a schema for a particular set.

restrictions.title: Restriction
restrictions.description: List of restrictions which determine who can view or manage the Legal Entity.

items.description:
Access control identifier that determines who can view or manage the Legal Entity.

**Purpose**: Restricts Legal Entity visibility based on scope permissions. Only users/applications 
with matching restrictions scopes can access Legal Entities with a specific restrictions value.

**Access Control**:
- *Reading*: Users can only query and view Legal Entities whose `restrictions` value matches one of their authorized restrictions.

**Validation**: The value must exist in the tenant's configured list of valid restrictions.
